children: Ocean Power Technologies reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results showing revenue of $1.703M, up from $1.182M a year earlier, while the company posted a net loss of $10.537M and basic and diluted loss per share of $(1.28) for the quarter — results disclosed in its 10-Q for the period ended July 31, 2026.
Revenue was $1.703M for the three months ended July 31, 2026, compared with $1.182M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 44.1%.
Net income: Net loss was $10.537M for the three months ended July 31, 2026, versus a net loss of $7.388M in the prior-year quarter (worsened YoY).
Diluted EPS: Basic and diluted net loss per share was $(1.28) for the three months ended July 31, 2026, unchanged from $(1.28) in the prior-year quarter.
Total revenue growth was driven by increased buoy operations and lease revenue.
Geographic mix shifted notably to the Americas, which accounted for about 80% of revenue, with Asia also growing and EMEA contribution declining versus the prior year.
Commercialization continued for PowerBuoy®, WAM-V® and Merrows™, with expanded defense and energy customers.
Backlog increased to $19.1M and the company completed the acquisition of in-process R&D assets to accelerate product development.
Management emphasized a push toward recurring, capital-light models including DaaS/RaaS/PaaS and growth in lease and service contracts.
